http_basic_notice.message: HTTP Basic credentials are sent without encryption. HTTPS is strongly recommended; only direct Basic authentication is supported.

site_rule_default_notice.message: Choose a narrower site rule; the default ^https?:// rule is not submitted.

import_legacy_warning.message: Encrypted files need the same Vault passphrase. The legacy plaintext example is for one-time migration and requires confirmation; imported data is encrypted, but the source file is not deleted.

webdav_intro.message: HTTPS protects transport; the Vault encrypts sync data before sending. Your Vault passphrase is never stored.

webdav_disclosure_heading.message: Data sent and visible to the provider:

webdav_disclosure_body.message: Sync sends your WebDAV username/password and encrypted ciphertext to the endpoint you configure. The provider can see the transport account, URL, timing, ciphertext size and ETag, but cannot read the ciphertext without Vault key material. Sync requires an unlocked Vault.

webdav_consent.message: I understand that this endpoint receives my WebDAV account and encrypted data, can see connection metadata, and I explicitly authorize sync on this device.

webdav_status_configure.message: Configure a WebDAV file URL to begin.

webdav_warning.message: Every endpoint must use HTTPS, including localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1]. Automatic sync refuses legacy plaintext files; keep a backup, review it, then explicitly choose Push local to migrate. Files over 5 MiB are rejected. Conflicts, remote deletion, empty credential sets or unreliable ETags pause automatic sync for review. Browser alarms may run late.

clear_sensitive_button.message: Clear all sensitive data on this device

clear_sensitive_warning.message: Requires confirmation. Clears local credentials/temp form data, WebDAV account/settings, sync metadata/backups, automatic-sync status and persistent Vault key material. Does not delete remote WebDAV files or downloaded files.

footer_disclaimer.message: Unofficial WebDAV Sync fork - $1. Based on MultiPass by Gilles Crettenand (original author, not this fork’s support contact).

local_storage_error.message: Local storage failed. Your changes may not have been saved.

vault_unlock_required.message: Unlock the Vault before accessing credentials.

import_rejected.message: Import rejected. Unlock the Vault and use a valid encrypted export/backup with the same passphrase.

legacy_import_confirmation.message: This is a legacy plaintext file. Import it only if you trust its source; it will be encrypted in the Vault. The original file will not be deleted automatically. Continue with this one-time migration?

vault_setup_description.message: The Vault encrypts local credentials/settings on first setup. Forgotten passphrases cannot be recovered; legacy plaintext WebDAV files are never overwritten automatically and require explicit Push local migration.

vault_risk_ack.message: I understand: forgotten passphrases cannot be recovered, and legacy plaintext WebDAV files are not automatically overwritten.

vault_passphrase_too_short.message: The passphrase must be at least 12 characters.

vault_ack_required.message: Confirm the unrecoverable-passphrase risk before continuing.

vault_locked_description.message: Authentication and sync are paused. Locking clears the stored Vault key; unlock with your passphrase to resume. It cannot revoke credentials cached by the browser or server sessions.

vault_recovery_notice.message: The encrypted Vault and migration data were preserved, but this unlock did not finish. Unlock again with the same passphrase.

vault_lock_pending_description.message: This page has stopped using credentials and is confirming revocation across other pages, the background process and session keys. Global lock has not yet been confirmed.

vault_global_revoke_unconfirmed.message: Global revocation could not be confirmed.

vault_lock_failure_description.message: This page remains paused and will not restore credentials, but global cleanup may have left session or persistent Vault key material behind. Retry; do not use the extension until global lock succeeds.

vault_unlocked_status.message: The Vault is unlocked. Authentication and sync can run.

vault_persistence_disclosure.message: The Vault stays unlocked across browser or app restarts until you lock it. Only Vault root-key material—not your passphrase—is stored locally; WebDAV account data remains encrypted. Anyone with access to this browser profile or extension can use the Vault and decrypt local data or sync ciphertext. Avoid shared devices.
vault_persistence_disclosure.description: Security disclosure for persistent Vault unlocked state.

webdav_vault_unavailable.message: Secure Vault is unavailable. Unlock the extension before using WebDAV sync.

webdav_vault_locked.message: Vault is locked. Unlock the extension before using WebDAV sync.

webdav_invalid_url.message: Enter a valid HTTPS WebDAV file URL.

webdav_https_required.message: HTTPS is required for every WebDAV endpoint, including localhost.

webdav_no_credentials_in_url.message: Do not put a username or password in the URL; use the separate fields.

webdav_no_tokens_in_query.message: Do not put authentication data or tokens in the URL query; use the separate fields.

webdav_no_fragment.message: The WebDAV URL must not contain a fragment.

webdav_read_local_credentials_failed.message: Could not read the local credentials.

webdav_invalid_credential_entry.message: The WebDAV file contains an invalid credential entry.

webdav_unknown_credential_fields.message: The WebDAV file contains unknown credential fields.

webdav_crypto_unavailable.message: This browser does not provide Web Crypto for sync revision checks.

webdav_legacy_format.message: This WebDAV file is a legacy plaintext/retired format. Automatic sync refuses it; download a backup, then use Push local and explicitly confirm migration.

webdav_invalid_format.message: The WebDAV file has an unsupported or invalid format; no data was changed.

webdav_unknown_fields.message: The WebDAV file contains unknown fields; no data was changed.

webdav_revision_mismatch.message: The WebDAV file revision does not match its credentials; no data was changed.

webdav_network_stopped.message: Vault is locked; WebDAV network access is stopped.

webdav_file_too_large.message: The WebDAV file exceeds the 5 MiB safety limit.

webdav_locked_before_access.message: Vault locked before WebDAV network access.

webdav_write_timeout.message: The WebDAV write timed out; it may have been written. Check the remote file before retrying.

webdav_request_timeout.message: The WebDAV request timed out; no automatic retry was attempted.

webdav_auth_failed.message: WebDAV authentication failed. Check the endpoint username and password.

webdav_invalid_json.message: The WebDAV file is not valid JSON.

webdav_legacy_unsupported.message: The WebDAV file is legacy plaintext or unsupported; automatic sync refused it. Download a backup, then use Push local and explicitly confirm migration.

webdav_decrypt_failed.message: The WebDAV file could not be decrypted; unlock the same Vault or inspect the remote file.

webdav_conditional_write_rejected.message: The server rejected the conditional write. Local data was retained; inspect both copies before syncing again.

webdav_create_conditional_rejected.message: The initial read found no remote file, but the create-only If-None-Match request failed (HTTP $1). No unconditional write was attempted; the remote state may have changed, or the server may not support conditional writes. Check the remote file and server before retrying.

webdav_write_missing_etag.message: The server accepted the write but did not return a strong ETag. Sync status is unknown; inspect the remote file before retrying.

webdav_create_write_missing_etag.message: The server accepted the create-only write but did not return a valid strong ETag. The remote file may now exist; no baseline was saved. Inspect it before retrying.

webdav_save_url_first.message: Save a WebDAV URL before syncing.

webdav_not_authorized.message: WebDAV sync is not authorized on this device. Review the disclosure and explicitly agree before saving or syncing.

webdav_interval_saved_invalid.message: The saved automatic sync interval is invalid. Review the WebDAV settings.

webdav_baseline_verify_failed.message: Could not verify the remote file body; no sync baseline was saved.

webdav_write_unconfirmed.message: The remote write could not be confirmed with the returned strong ETag; no baseline was saved. Inspect the remote file before retrying.

webdav_server_returned_different.message: The server returned a different document after writing; no baseline was saved. Inspect both copies before syncing again.

webdav_empty_upload_blocked.message: Automatic upload of an empty credential set is blocked. Use Push local explicitly if you intend to replace the remote file with an empty set.

webdav_local_changed_upload.message: Local credentials changed during sync. Nothing was uploaded; sync again.

webdav_uploaded_changes.message: Uploaded this device’s changes to WebDAV.

webdav_empty_download_blocked.message: Automatic download of an empty credential set is blocked. Use Pull remote explicitly if you intend to clear local credentials.

webdav_remote_revision_same.message: The remote timestamp/ETag changed, but the credential revision is unchanged; baseline refreshed without replacing local data.

webdav_remote_changed_sync.message: The remote file changed during sync. Nothing was replaced; sync again.

webdav_remote_revision_changed.message: The remote revision changed during sync. Nothing was replaced; sync again.

webdav_local_changed_pull.message: Local credentials changed during sync. Nothing was replaced; sync again.

webdav_downloaded_other_changes.message: Downloaded the other device’s changes. Previous local data is available as a backup.

webdav_action_create.message: No common sync baseline exists. Automatic sync did not create a remote file; use Sync now or Push local to initialize deliberately.

webdav_action_first_connect.message: This device has no common sync baseline. Choose Pull remote or Push local; automatic sync changed nothing.

webdav_action_missing_etag.message: The WebDAV server did not provide a strong ETag. Automatic sync stopped to prevent unsafe writes.

webdav_action_etag_inconsistent.message: The remote document changed without a matching strong ETag change. Automatic sync stopped; check the WebDAV server.

webdav_action_remote_deleted.message: The remote file was deleted after the last sync. Automatic sync did not recreate it.

webdav_action_conflict.message: Conflict: local credentials and the WebDAV file both changed since the shared baseline. Neither copy was overwritten; review both and choose Pull remote or Push local.

webdav_action_unchanged.message: Automatic sync check: both devices match the last shared revision.

webdav_action_disabled.message: Automatic WebDAV sync is disabled on this device.

webdav_action_stopped.message: Automatic sync stopped without changing data.

webdav_interval_range.message: Choose an automatic sync interval from 0 to 10080 minutes.

webdav_alarms_unavailable.message: This browser does not provide the alarms API.

webdav_first_sync_empty.message: The first sync will not create an empty remote file. Add credentials or use the explicit Push local action.

webdav_created_file.message: Created an encrypted WebDAV sync file using If-None-Match. This device now has a sync baseline.

webdav_no_remote_file.message: There is no remote file to download.

webdav_strong_etag_pull.message: The WebDAV server must return a strong ETag before pulling.

webdav_pull_confirm.message: Replace this device’s credentials with $1 entries from the encrypted WebDAV file? A local backup will be kept.

webdav_changed_during_confirm.message: The remote file changed while you were confirming. Nothing was replaced; review it and retry.

webdav_local_changed_confirm.message: Local credentials changed while you were confirming. Nothing was replaced; review and retry.

webdav_pull_success.message: Downloaded and decrypted the WebDAV file. Previous local data is available as an encrypted backup.

webdav_legacy_push_confirm.message: The remote file is legacy plaintext. Download/retain the local encrypted backup, then explicitly migrate it by replacing it with encrypted ciphertext? The legacy remote will not be preserved on the server.

webdav_strong_etag_overwrite.message: The server returned the remote file, but did not provide a valid strong ETag. It will not be overwritten. Verify the file URL and ETag support.

webdav_replace_confirm.message: Replace the current WebDAV file with this device’s $1 entries? The previous remote file will be saved as an encrypted local backup. The server stores encrypted ciphertext.

webdav_create_confirm.message: Create a new encrypted WebDAV file with this device’s $1 entries?

webdav_local_changed_push.message: Local credentials changed while you were confirming. Nothing was uploaded; review and retry.

webdav_push_success.message: Uploaded this device’s credentials. The WebDAV server stores ciphertext; it can still see the account, URL, timing, size and ETag.

webdav_backup_downloaded.message: Downloaded the latest local backup as an encrypted Vault backup.

webdav_consent_required.message: Read and accept the WebDAV data-use disclosure before saving or enabling sync.

webdav_settings_saved_auto.message: WebDAV settings and automatic sync interval saved on this device. Credentials stay local; the remote file is encrypted ciphertext.

webdav_settings_saved_manual.message: WebDAV settings saved on this device. Automatic sync is off.

webdav_revoke_confirm.message: Revoke WebDAV sync authorization? This stops automatic sync and clears the saved WebDAV password, sync baseline, backups, and consent on this device. Remote files and downloaded files are not deleted.

webdav_revoked.message: WebDAV sync authorization revoked. Remote and downloaded files still need separate deletion.

webdav_clear_confirm.message: Clear all credentials and sensitive data stored on this device, including persistent Vault root key material? Remote WebDAV files and already downloaded backup files are not deleted and must be removed separately.

webdav_cleared.message: All local credentials and sensitive WebDAV data were cleared. Remote and downloaded files were not deleted.

webdav_locked_status.message: Vault locked. WebDAV sync and network access are stopped.

webdav_unlocked_status.message: Vault unlocked. Review WebDAV settings and consent before syncing.

webdav_settings_load_failed.message: Could not load saved WebDAV settings.
